name: Filter — cabin class
description: Branches pass / fail. Pass when the request's cabin field matches one of the selected cabin tiers. Compiles down to a string-IN filter at evaluation time. Source field is restricted to fields whose name contains 'cabin' or 'class'.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The cabin field — pick a string field from your request whose name contains 'cabin' or 'class'.

params.name: literal
params.description: Which cabins should pass. Pick rows from ref-cabin-classes — by code (Y, J, F) or by tier (premium, standard, saver).

params.name: arraySelector
params.description: When the source resolves to multiple cabin values (e.g. one per segment), which match decides pass/fail.

enum.label: Any match
enum.description: Pass if at least one segment is in the list.

enum.label: All match
enum.description: Pass only if every segment is in the list.

enum.label: None match
enum.description: Pass only when no segment is in the list.

enum.label: First only
enum.description: Test the first segment only (e.g. outbound first leg).

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source path isn't in the request.
